summary: Peltola stated she "stands firmly with Israel and its right to defend" after October 2023, then voted with Republicans in May 2024 to approve arms for Israel over her party's objection. Her Senate campaign declined to confirm or deny that record in August 2026. A UDP-funded PAC, EDW Action Fund, spent $253,750 supporting her. Her November 2023 no-vote on a separate House aid package is the only contrary action, but the framing and pro-arms vote place her on Israel's side.
